entries.title: User-menu notes item with attention badge.
entries.notes: Opens the Filament user menu after seeding assigned, mentioned, or overdue note attention counts.
entries.useCase: An administrator sees the user-menu notes item with an attention badge.

entries.title: Notes inbox page.
entries.waitFor: body:has(article:has-text("[Notes demo] Resolved editorial question kept for workflow proof.")) article:has-text("[Notes demo] Confirm the revised sitemap copy before launch.")
entries.notes: Use a disposable local/testing screenshot App and set CAPELL_SCREENSHOT_USER_ADMIN_EMAIL (or CAPELL_SCREENSHOT_ADMIN_EMAIL) to the authenticated capture administrator. Entry setup prepares assigned, mentioned and overdue demo notes for that administrator. Capture fails if the seeded note is not visible.
entries.useCase: An administrator reviews assigned notes, mentions, and lifecycle actions from the inbox.

entries.title: Record-level Add note modal.
entries.notes: Opens the real Create note Filament header action on a page edit record.
entries.useCase: An administrator leaves contextual record-level notes from the Capell page edit surface.

entries.title: Empty notes inbox state.
entries.notes: Use a disposable local/testing screenshot App and set CAPELL_SCREENSHOT_USER_ADMIN_EMAIL (or CAPELL_SCREENSHOT_ADMIN_EMAIL) to the authenticated capture administrator. Entry setup prepares an empty inbox, refusing non-demo notes; teardown re-seeds demo notes.
entries.useCase: An administrator sees the default empty inbox state when no notes need attention.

entries.title: Notes inbox with assigned, mentioned, and lifecycle controls.
entries.waitFor: body:not(:has(article:has-text("[Notes demo] Resolved editorial question kept for workflow proof."))) article:has-text("[Notes demo] Confirm the revised sitemap copy before launch.")
entries.notes: Use a disposable local/testing screenshot App and set CAPELL_SCREENSHOT_USER_ADMIN_EMAIL (or CAPELL_SCREENSHOT_ADMIN_EMAIL) to the authenticated capture administrator. Entry setup prepares assigned, mentioned and overdue demo notes for that administrator. Capture fails if the seeded note is not visible. Filter to Open so this evidence differs from the unfiltered inbox. The unfiltered inbox also contains a resolved note authored by the capture administrator; Open excludes it.
entries.useCase: An administrator filters to open assigned and mentioned notes, resolves notes, and completes assignments.

entries.title: Notes inbox page with admin sidebar menu open.
entries.notes: Shows the main inbox at /admin/notes. Capture this same admin surface with the fully collapsible sidebar opened.
entries.useCase: An administrator reviews assigned notes, mentions, and lifecycle actions from the inbox.
